lines.3: 「People who say that are always the biggest kids. Take this!」
lines.4: Yashi nimbly dodged the pillow Crab threw.
lines.5: I threw one back at the Princess.
lines.14: Yoshimi timidly tossed a pillow at me.
lines.15: It was adorable, so I lightly tossed it back without enough force to hurt.
lines.16: 「I'm old enough to know better, and I'm still getting carried away with a pillow fight!」
lines.17: 「Hmm. Let me throw the next one a little harder!」
lines.20: There was a painful smack as the pillow buried itself in his face.
lines.26: 「You dodged! Then I'll attack you directly!」
lines.27: Crab held the pillow and pummeled Yoshimi over the head with it.
lines.29: 「I'll purify you, Yoppi! Raging Explosive Style!」
lines.33: Yoshimi covered her head and simply endured the assault.
lines.35: 「Now to nail Nagomin with a pillow.」
lines.36: 「This is a perfect opportunity to teach her a proper lesson.」
lines.38: 「It is stupid, but I never turn down a fight someone brings to me.」
lines.40: The Princess hurled a pillow overhand.
lines.42: Yashi calmly swatted the flying pillow down.
lines.44: This time, Yashi forcefully threw the pillow she was holding.
lines.46: The Princess leaped gracefully and kicked the flying pillow straight back with a thump.
lines.48: Startled, Yashi dodged it with superb reflexes.
lines.49: The pillow smacked against the gym roof!
lines.51: 「You are impressive too, Nagomin. But next...」
lines.53: 「What do you think you are doing?!」
lines.55: The instant she said it, the Princess hooked a futon with her foot and flung it upward.
lines.56: The billowing futon hid the Princess from view for a moment...
lines.57: By the time it flopped back to the floor, she was already gone.
lines.60: We could only stand there dumbfounded.
